meta.title: PuntPoints and rewards | Puntr
meta.description: PuntPoints reward eligible activity and invites and can be redeemed for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks once rewards open. No cash.
meta.ogDescription: PuntPoints reward activity, never results. No cash value.

title: PuntPoints and rewards
subtitle: A loyalty scheme for active members. Points reward activity, never results.

soon.title: PuntPoints are on their way
soon.body: Earn PuntPoints for eligible activity and invites, then redeem them for vouchers, sponsored rewards and perks. A planned Tipster Support feature will also let Punters recognise verified Tipsters with a consistent track record by sending them PuntPoints. Points have no cash value.

signIn.body: Sign in to see your balance, invite friends and redeem rewards.

confirm.title: Confirm your email to earn and redeem points.
confirm.body: Points and rewards are for members with a confirmed email address.

earn.title: How to earn
earn.body: Points come from activity, never from winning, and never from spending.

rules.note: PuntPoints have no cash value, cannot be bought or exchanged for money, and never change rankings or leaderboard results. Until Tipster Support launches under its published rules, PuntPoints cannot be transferred between members. We may reverse points earned through fraud or abuse. Rewards are provided by our partners and subject to their terms.

tipSupport.title: Support standout Tipsters
tipSupport.body: Puntr Pro will introduce Tipster Support: Punters will be able to recognise verified Tipsters with a consistent track record by sending them PuntPoints. Points have no cash value and can't be withdrawn, and support never affects rankings. This feature is planned and is not available yet.
